These pinned browser distributions retain their upstream license headers and are served locally so commerce and studio controls do not depend on third-party CDN availability.

- Three.js r128: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js — MIT
- GSAP 3.12.2: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.2/gsap.min.js — upstream GSAP license
- ScrollTrigger 3.12.2: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.2/ScrollTrigger.min.js — upstream GSAP license

For upgrades, replace verified upstream artifacts, retain their license notices, and rerun browser QA. Do not modify the minified vendor files directly.
